sources.o: Obsidian approved Core Concept+Tone, May-2026; intent

findings.statement: Thorin is protagonist; Filena/Kilin/Mhordred playable allies; Tordan father/general; Balastrus antagonist→redeemed ally. Actors 3-6 statically match party.

Rheed frames pre-Daratrine Gildrat: mining breaks Melios's seal, frees Ignotos and exposes Thorin's forbidden Mana inheritance. Approved 2026 intent fixes catastrophe; choices shape identity/relations.
Ekios lore centers Gildrat, Kravens, Melios, sewer mine and Coreto/Daratrine frame: caste, mining, ancestral memory, Ignotos, fall/refuge.
Arc: football rebel→miner→seal rupture→faction prep→defense/possession. Voices: pragmatic Gildrat, oniric Thorin/Mélia, oral Rheed. Map text cannot validate tone/pacing.

Sigmetal, Filena/Conselho and five prep tracks branch, then converge on defense/purification. Older GDD has multiple/A-B-C endings; approved 2026 fixes core events with epilogue variants. Reachability untested.
Index omits detailed narrative docs. Obsidian mixes approved intent, duplicates/templates and unrelated Game Jam material.
